The '''palace''' of [[Noble/Legends|noblewoman]] [[Regera Girawn]] was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kruskan]]. Girawn's servants brought a [[Sith holocron (Kruskan)|Sith holocron]] they had discovered in the nearby [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] to the palace to present to their mistress. When Girawn handled the holocron, it released a blast of [[Purple|purplish]] light that destroyed the holocron and left the noblewoman's [[Limb/Legends|hands]] and face burned.<ref name="RGFW" />
